meta_title: VPN Split Tunneling by Country | VpnHood!
meta_description: Route traffic through or around the VPN by the country it is going to, or exclude your own country entirely. Available in VpnHood!
title: Split tunneling by country
lead: Route traffic through or around the VPN based on the country it is going to.
shot_alt: The Split tunneling by country screen in the VpnHood! app
how_desc: Destinations are matched by country. Exclude your own country and local services connect directly at full speed while everything abroad goes through the tunnel, or turn it around and tunnel only the countries you choose.
when_desc: Exclude My Country is the everyday setting: local banking, delivery and government sites keep working, and the VPN handles the rest.
cost_desc: Traffic to an excluded country reveals your real IP address to those sites. That is the deal you are making for speed.
